name: A-Share Core Stock Analysis
description: Analyzes institutional behavior of Chinese A-share core holdings using market regime, index leadership, ETF flow, relative strength, chip distribution, institution cost zone, and national-team logic instead of literal main-capital flow.

name: Novel Atlas
description: Turns a full novel into one ultra-high-resolution atlas image holding its timeline, cast and irreversible events: designs a blueprint of tiled zones, writes and voice-edits the label copy before measuring it, generates one image per zone, then composites tiles and text into a single picture locally.

name: XHS Story
description: Turns a real idea-to-shipped process into a 7-page Xiaohongshu (rednote) image carousel with a paste-ready caption, structured as 起承转合. Recovers authentic detail from session transcripts and renders all Chinese text with CSS + headless Chrome instead of an image model.
